semantic_fidelity.reason: All six source concepts and six directed historical relationships are visible, with verify/enqueue/write/read correctly owned. CLI-to-gateway and queue-to-worker remain unlabeled; no protocol invented. Separate auth read and worker write routes are preserved, with no extra visible relation. arrow_traceability.reason: All six static source stems and unique downward arrowheads are traceable without crossings or fake external branches. However the fixed category explicitly says an off-origin starting dot makes direction unproven: all six frame-0 dots start one cell after the first drawn cell. Therefore all six required-edge audits fail this strengthened gate (F01), despite correct static arrow topology.

layout_fit.reason: Actual ANSI grid is 77x47 at natural 100%; origin scrollback preserves viewport: 77x47 zoom: 1.00 natural. Live outer Herdr pane is 79x49 at x80,y0; 1-cell chrome leaves 77x47. findings.description: KNOWN DEFECT: all six frame-0 dots start on the second drawn route cell, one cell downstream of the actual first cell after their source port. This directly fails animation origin and, under the explicit arrow_traceability rule, leaves every animated direction unproven. Static arrowheads and label meanings remain recoverable; no source relation is claimed reversed.

EVIDENCE GAP / BLOCKER: frame 20 at the claimed 3000ms finish still shows all six dots upstream of their arrowheads. No sampled frame shows even one arrowhead arrival, much less all six together. The long capture plus recovered frame 0 is a 0-3000ms window, not evidence of a completed rendered cycle. Eventual synchronization, eventual unequal duration, or impossibility of arrival cannot be inferred. Synchronization is blocked; known origin failure still makes animation fail.

KNOWN VERIFICATION DEFECT: generation.md claims frame 0 shows origins and frame 20 shows all dots at their arrowheads, while the cited captured cells show neither. generation.json, --check origins 6/6 and synchronization diagnostics, and the green primary validator do not establish those visual assertions. Reproducible hashes are valid, but this materially incorrect interpretation breaks required reliable evidence. Full origin validator output is also not retained: its file has only three attempt-budget PASS lines.

EVIDENCE GAP / BLOCKER: attempts.json reports two rejected preflight drafts (top-level duration_ms rejection and explicit-layer routing failure) but explicitly says their specs were not preserved. Exact failed invocation records, full raw stdout/stderr and exit statuses are absent from this bundle. Reported field/spacing capability gaps are therefore not independently reproducible from these failed-attempt records; do not invent missing logs or treat their summaries as executed proof.

blockers: B01 (F02): no actual rendered full-cycle/arrival evidence. Need preserved origin and final common-arrowhead-arrival frames for all six routes; eventual arrival behavior is unobserved, not pass. No new session was run to repair this review.

B02 (F04): two rejected draft specs and their exact raw failed command/stdout/stderr/exit records are unavailable; origin-validator output is only an excerpt. These workflow gaps do not erase known F01/F03 failures.
